notes.title: Update v1.1.009
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Player HP number will now be displayed.
[*] Skills that accumulate with Annihilator usage will now include uses prior to obtaining the skill.
[/list]

Initially, the purpose of Annihilator accumulation skills was to encourage frequent usage of the Annihilator. Therefore, uses before acquiring the skill will now count as well, better aligning with the intended encouragement of Annihilator usage.

Recently, players have reported issues with leaderboard displays. After thorough investigation, I suspect this could be due to data retrieval issues from Steam servers. Unfortunately, I haven't yet found a suitable solution. I apologize for the inconvenience, and I'll update immediately once a better method is identified.

notes.title: Developer Report and Version Update
notes.notes:
In this update, we have finally implemented the long-awaited custom keybinding feature!
Although the development process took more time than expected, players can now freely adjust their key settings. We’ve also added custom slots for features like refreshing during upgrades, making gameplay more flexible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44602886/19097f468f628bedf21b4fbbd5df4399866108f6.jpg[/img]

Additionally, we’ve started designing brand-new content for the future,
including upcoming costumes and characters.
Since production time is difficult to estimate accurately, we ask for your patience and understanding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44602886/84971f2f4b1948bb55d0d8214aab4ae7a644a063.png[/img]

Thank you for your support and patience.

Our apologies, but due to an increase in content, we will be pushing our release back once more. To show our gratitude for your patience, we have decided to release an update to our demo!

In the new demo, players will be able to:
1. Enjoy a complete H-scene
2. Choose between multiple story branches
3. Learn more about the lore with an updated story
4. View the various monsters in memory mode

We also fixed a few bugs that were in the old demo.
